/api/job.notes: No Server header. No CORS header. x-clacks-overhead is an OctoPrint easter egg present on all Flask-served routes. vary: Cookie appears on 403 and on /plugin/appkeys/probe but not on this authenticated 200.

/webcam/?action=snapshot.cache-control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, pre-check=0, post-check=0, max-age=0
/webcam/?action=snapshot.notes: Served by mjpg-streamer, not by OctoPrint. HTTP/1.0, no content-length (connection-close framing), no auth required. x-timestamp is a float uptime-style capture timestamp. Backdated expires header defeats caching.

/plugin/prusaslicerthumbnails/thumbnail/.notes: Static file route. etag is the file mtime as a bare integer in quotes. Requires X-Api-Key. The query string on the thumbnail URL is a cache-buster, not a parameter.

/plugin/appkeys/probe.notes: 204 with an explicit content-type: text/plain and content-length: 0.
